correctness.rationale: For K_{p,q} with p<=q, N>=3 and s=ch, the Laplacian spectrum is 0,q (p−1),p (q−1),N. Exact projectors give diagonal F_A=1/N+(p−1)r(qs)/p+q*r(Ns)/(pN), and G_B analogously. Differentiation verifies r'<0 and φ(z)=(1−r(z))/z has φ'<0 for z>0: within-class off-diagonal entries are positive differences φ(ps)−φ(Ns) or φ(qs)−φ(Ns), cross-class entry (1−r(Ns))/N>0. Both diagonal functions strictly decrease 1 to 2/N−1 and G_B>=F_A (strict when p<q), yielding a unique cutoff from F_A=0. K_{1,1} has all entries strictly positive for finite s>0. For t=qs, F_A(t/q)−r(t) is O(1/q) uniformly for 1<=p<=q on each compact t-set; r has one simple positive zero z0≈4.644370709, so qs*=z0+O(1/q). Independently differentiated scalar identities and compared full rational Laplacian matrices in small bicliques; no extrapolation from finite tests for universal cutoff.
